title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Protection Cover Carried and Charged
content:
Each of the six Car Rental Rate Classes either carries a protection product in the rate or charges for it per rental day. The cover schedule is as follows.

| Rate class | Waiver included | Waiver per day (USD) | Waiver excess (USD) | Theft protection included | Theft protection per day (USD) | Third party liability limit (USD) | Personal accident per day (USD) | Roadside assistance included | Roadside assistance per day (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | no | 29.99 | 1500.00 | no | 13.99 | 100000.00 | 8.99 | no | 7.99 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | no | 27.99 | 1200.00 | no | 12.99 | 300000.00 | 8.99 | no | 7.49 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | no | 25.99 | 950.00 | no | 11.99 | 500000.00 | 7.99 | yes | 0.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0.00 | 500.00 | yes | 0.00 | 1000000.00 | 6.99 | yes | 0.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 2000000.00 | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | no | 21.99 | 750.00 | no | 9.99 | 1000000.00 | 5.99 | yes | 0.00 |

The waiver excess is the amount the renter still bears on a damage claim after the collision damage waiver. The third party liability limit is the cover the class itself carries. Where a class includes a product, its per-day amount is published as 0, because the product is in the rate rather than sold beside it.

**Two readings of the same schedule.**

*Cover a renter holds without buying anything.* On the Premium Inclusive Rate the waiver, theft protection and roadside assistance are all carried, the waiver excess is 0 and third party liability runs to 2000000. On the Inclusive Flex Rate the same three are carried, but the waiver excess stands at 500 and liability at 1000000.

*Cover a renter must buy.* On the Pay Now Saver Rate none of the three is carried: the waiver runs at 29.99 a day against an excess of 1500, theft protection at 13.99 a day, roadside assistance at 7.99 a day and liability at 100000. The Pay Now Standard Rate runs 27.99, 12.99 and 7.49 a day against an excess of 1200 and liability of 300000. The Pay At Counter Flex Rate carries roadside assistance but charges 25.99 and 11.99 a day for the other two, against an excess of 950 and liability of 500000. The Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate likewise carries roadside assistance and charges 21.99 and 9.99 a day, against an excess of 750 and liability of 1000000. Personal accident cover is charged on five classes, at 8.99, 8.99, 7.99, 6.99 and 5.99 a day, and carried at 0 on the Premium Inclusive Rate.
